description:
Select an artboard layer group by artboard_id (preferred) or unique name so subsequent edits and Select All target that board.

Use when: switching between device frames in an artboard document.
Do NOT use when: switching document tabs — use photoshop_set_active_document.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { artboard } }.
Preconditions: target artboard exists (photoshop_list_artboards). Side effects: changes the active layer.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name.description: Exact artboard name (ambiguous if duplicates — use artboard_id)

name: photoshop_set_active_artboard
